scripts.start-mobile: HOST=0.0.0.0 BROWSER=none react-scripts start & sleep 4 && osascript -e 'tell application "Google Chrome" to open location "http://localhost:3000"' && osascript -e 'tell application "Google Chrome" to activate' && osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to keystroke "i" using {option down, command down}' && sleep 2 && osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to keystroke "m" using {shift down, command down}'
scripts.android-emulator:
HOST=0.0.0.0 BROWSER=none react-scripts start & sleep 3 && open -a 'Android Studio' && echo '
🚀 React app running on http://localhost:3000
📱 Open Android Studio > Tools > AVD Manager > Start Emulator
🌐 In emulator browser, go to: http://10.0.2.2:3000
'
scripts.ios-simulator:
HOST=0.0.0.0 BROWSER=none react-scripts start & sleep 3 && open -a Simulator && echo '
🚀 React app running on http://localhost:3000
📱 iOS Simulator opened - open Safari and go to localhost:3000
'
scripts.vscode-mobile:
HOST=0.0.0.0 BROWSER=none react-scripts start && echo '
🚀 React app running on http://localhost:3000
📱 In VSCode: Cmd+Shift+P > Live Preview: Show Preview (External Browser)
📱 Then toggle device mode in preview
'
